---
name: code-review
description: Use when reviewing marketplace changes for correctness, regressions, security, tests, maintainability, scope, and documentation.
---

Read the spec and diff, trace changed behavior, and review findings first ordered by severity. Check edge cases, authorization, failure states, migration safety, tests, performance, docs, and unrelated changes. Distinguish verified findings from questions and residual risk.

Do not summarize before reporting issues.
